scope: Small authored English paraphrase fixture; not a general retrieval benchmark.

records.text: The nightly job stalled whenever a partner's endpoint went quiet. I added a timeout and a queue that tried the request again later.
Nobody knew who should sign off the final draft. I brought the designer and editor together and wrote down which decisions each could make.
The two organisers refused to speak to each other after an argument. I listened to both separately, then helped them agree a way to work together again.
We could afford only one venue. I compared the hire prices, travel costs and expected attendance, then chose the option that left enough money for equipment.
An assistant generated the database migration. I checked its output against the records and corrected two errors before a colleague deployed it.
I planted tomatoes in the greenhouse, watered them every morning and picked the ripe fruit in August.
